The Ichthys LNG Project is operated by INPEX Operations Australia Pty Ltd as the delegated operator.
TotalEnergies is a major partner in the Ichthys LNG Project.
The Ichthys gas and condensate field contains the Central Processing Facility (CPF), which removes water and most condensate from reservoir fluids.
The Central Processing Facility (CPF) transfers separated condensate to the Floating Production, Storage and Offloading (FPSO) facility.
The Floating Production, Storage and Offloading (FPSO) facility exports condensate directly from the field at an average rate of up to 85,000 barrels per day.
Reservoir fluids are transferred to the Floating Production, Storage and Offloading (FPSO) facility for further processing.
Condensate is processed at the Floating Production, Storage and Offloading (FPSO) facility before export.
Condensate is exported through the Gas Export Pipeline (GEP) to the ILNG Facility.
The Gas Export Pipeline (GEP) terminates at the ILNG Facility at Bladin Point in Darwin Harbour.
The Floating Production, Storage and Offloading (FPSO) facility is moored approximately 3.5 km from the CPF.

The Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) defines Hold Points as points in the production sequence where no further processing or manufacturing shall take place until attendance has been carried out by all nominated parties.
The Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) defines Witness Points as points where the nominated party shall be invited to inspect an activity, but production need not stop due to non-attendance.

The Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) defines Monitor Points as points where the nominated party shall randomly inspect or verify the activity on a periodical basis, commensurate with the perceived level of criticality or risk to the overall integrity of the work.

The Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) defines Review Points as points where a review and/or sign-off of the referenced records/documents is carried out by the nominated parties for a specific ITP activity.

The Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) defines Approval Points as points where an approval sign-off of a referenced record/document is carried out by the nominated party for a specific ITP activity, and subsequent production shall not proceed without completing the approval sign-off.
Subsequent production cannot proceed without completing the approval sign-off at Approval Point (A).
